[LCCO.3.8] **A continued `call` inside a synthesized body names its
correlation.** A `call` that carries a continuation ([LCCO.2.1]) and is written
in the body of an `after` clause or of another call's continuation — a body a
synthesized terminal runs ([RLOW.14.7]) — must carry an `as` whose key is a
string literal. The compiler must refuse such a call with no `as` or with a
computed `as`, with `DS_VALIDATE_NESTED_CONTINUED_CALL_AS`.

Such a call takes no value from the correlation counter ([LCCO.3.7]). The same
call outside a synthesized body is unaffected: with no `as` or a computed `as` it
takes its value as [LCCO.3.7] item 1 says.
